title: Privacy Policy
description: This Privacy Policy explains how bigbi studio collects and protects your information across our website, products, and digital services.

content.text: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how **bigbi studio** collects, uses, and protects information when you use our website, digital products, and services.
We may collect information you provide directly and basic information about how you use our website and services.

items: Name and email address when you contact us or use our services
Project or inquiry details you choose to provide
Basic usage data such as pages viewed and interactions
Technical information such as browser and device type
Provide and improve our website, products, and services
Respond to inquiries and communicate with you
Manage projects and deliver requested services
Understand how our website is used

content.text: We may use cookies and analytics tools to understand website usage, improve performance, and maintain the site. Where required, we will request your consent before using non-essential cookies.
We may use trusted third-party services for hosting, analytics, payments, communication, and other business operations. These providers process information according to their own privacy policies.
We take reasonable measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information, or withdraw consent where applicable.
To exercise your rights, please contact us through the contact information provided on our website.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact **bigbi studio** through our Contact page.
